items.q: A 58-year-old man has sudden severe right leg pain with a pale cold foot and absent pulses. The six bedside features summarising acute limb ischaemia are?
o: Pain with pallor, pulselessness, paraesthesia, paralysis and perishing cold
Fever with cough, wheeze and sputum
Itch with rash, weals and swelling
Thirst with polyuria and weight loss
items.exp: The six Ps compress the ESVS acute limb ischaemia picture into one bedside list, and any threatened limb earns immediate heparin with revascularisation against the clock.
r: Correct. Six Ps flag dying limbs.
items.kp: Six Ps summarise acute limb ischaemia.
